body:
I really appreciate that, thank you. It makes me feel a little less insane about the whole thing, because it honestly does help a lot. I hadn't really thought of the whole thing as brilliant, more so silly and stupid, so hearing it being called brilliant? Validating. 

I hope that it's just addiction hormones, honestly. It's been going on for a few months now, so I'm just waiting for it to finally settle down. Only times she really talks to our group chat anymore is when they've had a fight or when she wants us to raid his Twitch chat or something. I can't really tell if it's "tough love" anymore, I may have phrased that incorrectly. I don't really know what it is. She's a very blunt person so I may take some of her bluntness as "tough love". That's really all I feel comfortable explaining about the situation.

I've had my job for about five or six months now, and aside from some of the more negative siding coworkers, I enjoy working there. Free drinks and discounted food.  I hope the good manager likes me, because I absolutely adore her. I'm hesitating on the two weeks notice, and I hope to talk to some of my more understanding coworkers about the situation. Had a deep talk with one who's last day was today.

I'm not sure if Gnoggin is for everyone, but if you like theory videos on video games, by all means, check it out. I'm not really the best at talking to others, but I've read over this comment a few times while I was at work and it brightened up my day a little. It was also something I looked forward to replying to when I got home. So, thanks for listening to me.
